entry_points.text: Initialization allocates groups with dedicated tables preparing caches and hashes reporting failures via audit panic. Handlers verify group ownership warning once on mismatch; creation and move set identity, deletion clears it, self-delete, unmount and self-move trigger teardown; tree inode handler is inert deferring effects to freeing.

exports.text: Daemon term or user signals snapshot sender thread-group, login and label globally then record recipient inline first with overflow in chained blocks; skipped when off or no context, overflow reports allocation or capacity failure.

Watch helpers compare device and inode unless unset, duplicate path with shared parent, and refresh the matching watch by rebuilding rules onto new hash placement under filter mutex, panicking without install on duplication failure.

Rule-change logging emits configuration records with session, operation label, untrusted path, key, list and success when enabled; automatic removal couples logging with rule deletion on self-delete, unmount or self-move.

Rule duplication copies scalar control and field storage into fresh entry sharing tree handle, deep-copies LSM, key and executable mark transferring watch; failures detach partial mark, free entry and report error pointer distinguishing exhaustion.

Inode filtering bypasses daemon under RCU walking names in order to first bucket match; class match validates number and class before bit test; registration builds zeroed mask from terminated list rejecting duplicate or range errors; registry is fixed null-initialized array with numbers checked against words times thirty two.

LSM refresh sweeps all filter classes under mutex preserving earliest failure; task context creation honors fast path and disabled shutdown with counters visible; unlinked entries reclaim via RCU callback through standard free; serving as external task and policy hooks.

hazards.text: Out-of-range values yield no match safely; missing context yields no match; daemon bypasses filtering; unknown selectors warn; group mismatch and overflow warn once ignored; compiled-out tree kill faults; under-referenced mark is fatal.

invariants.text: Per-inode filtering hashes inode to bucket then applies operation filtering; mask test rejects out-of-range values or word indexes before checking rule bit.

Rules need priority advance and full match updating key and priority, never to disabled always to record. Checks cover identity, arch-gated exit and args, credentials with membership, device via name or list, watch and tree with negation, single-fetch subject with layered object, delegated permission, file type and cross-field; file needs set mode, tree covers full then partial thirty-one-slot chunks.

LSM duplication copies source text then reinitializes rule object, retaining temporary invalidity with warning as success for later reload; refresh leaves security-unknown rules unchanged else swaps linkage with grace-aware replace deferring old reclaim.

Parent length gives directory prefix ignoring empties and trailing duplicates; comparison checks final component deriving parent when full-path requested. Lookup returns referenced chunk only on key equality under read protection; membership scans owners. Killed accessor needs usable context. Pinning fills block, grows, unwinds beyond checkpoint, freeing blocks separately; growth failures abandon record.

Auditable moves once idle to record; reuse clears per-operation evidence deriving priority from intent keeping key only for record, dummy skipping payload. Task filter defaults build transferring key only on record; exit filters bypass daemon under read protection using stored discriminator; return starts invalid becoming success or failure.

Special records select shape by type emitting time only for changed or nonzero distinguishing clear, set and unknown. Execve keeps bounded multi-record capture treating uncopyable userspace as fatal. Title capture trims trailing nonprint clearing on free. Teardown releases names, auxiliary chains, module name when applicable, address and tree pins resetting to neutral.

Disabled build provides guard with inert fallbacks: watch and inode filtering no-ops, comparison mismatch, executable duplication invalid, tree termination fault; both units prefix logs with module name.

Globals hold separate groups for marks, trees and watches with prune worker, mark cache and fixed hash with aligned spin. Mark teardown frees path and wrapper, watch frees parent, tree recycles mark; chunks free only after last reference via callback and destructor.

locks.text: Operation filtering uses RCU iteration testing mask before predicate; parent teardown holds filter mutex across safe walk logging removals, detaching marks, unlinking lists and removing watches, releasing before destroying mark.

Prune and kill use control outer with filter mutex inner releasing filter around per-victim work; eviction uses filter mutex outer with hash spin inner; mark freeing uses group lock outer with hash inner detaching chunk, fatal on under-reference.

state_machines.text: Mark handling verifies group ownership then on create, move or delete refreshes watched inode when affected name matches stored path, while self-delete, unmount or self-move logs automatic removal and deletes owning rule.

structs.text: Modes are disabled, build on demand, record mandatory. Rule node has linkage with deferred reclaim; capability snapshot holds sets with shared slot. Path record has name, flags, filesystem, ownership, label, capabilities and type; title has length and pointer; event pairs time with serial; five slots, negative one for full-path.

Core context holds lifecycle, event, operation with args, outcome, priority, names, key, filesystem and network state, credentials and tree data with dummy marker. Extended holds signal target, descriptors with title, type tag and variant payload across socket, interprocess, queue, capability, mapping, open, exec, module and time.

Aux anchor is discriminated node; identity has sixteen entries; file capabilities hold versioned state with old and new snapshots; tree refs are thirty-one-slot blocks; netlink binds port with namespace, watch holds directory and child; execve seventy-five hundred, title one hundred twenty eight, return zero invalid one success two failure.

Mark wrapper binds device, inode and path to mark with rule; trees link counted nodes, chunks carry hash, key, mark, residents and counted owners; watches link device, path, inode, parent and rule. Events cover move, create, delete and self actions plus unmount for watches; chunk hash one hundred twenty eight, buckets thirty two.

Filtering uses two arrays of eight lists for live and management views with mutex-protected mutation; operator table maps internal comparisons to external codes; priority starts at half maximum and one less; netfilter table names xt and nft operations; watch operations bind handler with release.
